summary: Build a cache that discards the item left unused for the longest time. Capacity is an integer from 1 to 3000. Keys run from 0 to 3000 and values run from 0 to 104. Calls to get and put together number at most 3 times 104. get writes the stored value when the key is present and writes -1 when the key is absent, and that read counts as a use. put writes a new pair or overwrites an old one. When the count of keys would exceed capacity, delete the key that has gone the longest without a get or a put, then store the new key.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is one command per line.
